items.title: Deterministic code graph and change-impact context
items.rationale: AKP ships a revisioned CODE projection, bounded graph substrate, symbol/change-impact queries, failure semantics and recovery evidence.

items.title: Graphify extraction adapter
items.rationale: AKP executes the pinned Graphify adapter in remote CI while keeping Graphify optional and derived-state only.

items.title: GitNexus / GraphCoder / RepoGraph same-task parity
items.rationale: No same-task-set executable adapter for these external systems is part of v0.4, so AKP makes no parity or superiority claim from README or heterogeneous results.

items.title: Scoped Team Context Workspace and operator UX
items.rationale: AKP provides durable sessions, revision pins, claims/handoffs, scoped principals, governed promotion and human/team Web surfaces.

items.title: External agent-workspace same-flow comparison
items.rationale: The registered competitive arena does not execute these external systems on the same governed workspace flow, so v0.4 leaves the comparison explicit and unclaimed.

items.title: Bounded retrieval, context assembly and safe reasoning
items.rationale: AKP ships exact/lexical/vector/typed-graph retrieval, bounded context assembly, a typed reasoning plan runtime and an agent context facade with registered evaluation.

items.title: External retrieval-system same-corpus comparison
items.rationale: External comparators remain NOT_EXECUTED unless same-corpus evidence is supplied; v0.4 does not copy published benchmark scores into AKP claims.

items.title: Bi-temporal truth and support maintenance
items.rationale: AKP provides current/as-of truth queries, support withdrawal, stale-derived rejection and durable truth revision state with recovery evidence.

items.title: Graphiti same-scenario temporal comparison
items.rationale: The competitive manifest requires a registered external temporal scenario report before any comparison can be treated as executed.

items.title: Durable claims, work context, handoff and agent resume
items.rationale: AKP separates system-of-record objects, coordination state and approved knowledge while providing leases/fencing, handoffs, promotion review and context bootstrap.

items.title: External multi-agent coordination same-flow comparison
items.rationale: No same-flow executable external run is registered for v0.4; the Agent Arena compares AKP access arms rather than relabelling an external coordination product as executed.

items.title: Capability-declared connectors and authenticated inbox
items.rationale: AKP ships connector capability contracts, local/Git integration, authenticated webhook/inbox handling, checkpoints, replay/idempotency and assurance findings.

items.title: First-party adapters for every external system of record
items.reference: GitHub / GitLab / Jira / Linear / Slack / Teams families
items.rationale: v0.4 defines the interoperable connector contract and minimum real adapters but does not claim first-party production adapters for every named external system.
